english: Tomorrow is Sunday. I want to go to the bookstore with my younger sister. I want to buy a Chinese book, and she wants to buy a cup.
reference: 明天是星期天。我想和妹妹去书店。我想买一本汉语书,她要买一个杯子。

grammar.example: 我想买一本汉语书,她要买一个杯子

issues.description: The reference renders "want to" as 想 in the first part and 要 in the second. Learners who write 她想买一个杯子 are equally correct, so the automatic grader should accept both 想 and 要.
书店 (bookstore) and 星期天 may be slightly beyond a strict HSK 1 vocabulary list. They are very common and easy to infer from 书 and 星期, so this is only a small level concern.
